content.rationale: The verb takes its context, loads and saves the marker state through markers_persist, answers with markers_guards' transition, reverts through the revert module, reads the op head through the op log, reads the working copy.s divergence through M-jj-divergence (xoroywoy), and builds its refusals through refusal; building the gate's own crate typechecks all seven calls at once, so the fan-out is gated without a second owner for the crate. Its edges span two cells — the verb's natural-to-code fidelity cell and the code-to-code calls — so the criterion stays its inline cargo command; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
